title: Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios)
description:
VENDEDOR EXTERNO (GESTOR DE NEGÓCIOS) – COMERCIAL PJ


A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. Com uma trajetória marcada pela excelência e inovação, a empresa oferece soluções completas e personalizadas para atender às necessidades de segurança de seus clientes, sejam eles residenciais, comerciais ou industriais.

A atuação da Patrimonial Segurança é pautada em três pilares fundamentais:


· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

· Equipe Altamente Capacitada: Os profissionais da Patrimonial Segurança passam por rigorosos processos de seleção, treinamento contínuo e atualizações, assegurando que estejam preparados para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios de segurança.

· Atendimento Personalizado: Cada cliente recebe uma análise detalhada das necessidades de segurança, resultando em planos de ação específicos, capazes de prevenir riscos e proteger bens e pessoas de maneira eficaz.

A empresa se destaca por sua ética profissional, compromisso com a qualidade e foco na construção de relacionamentos de confiança com seus clientes.

Com presença sólida na região de Chapecó e Itajaí, a Patrimonial Segurança é mais do que uma prestadora de serviços; é uma parceira estratégica na proteção de bens e na promoção da tranquilidade.

Estamos em busca de um (a) Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios (a)) – Comercial PJ para integrar nosso time!


1. Objetivo da Função

Atuar na prospecção, venda e gestão de novos contratos, além de realizar o atendimento e manutenção da carteira ativa de clientes, garantindo resultados comerciais consistentes e alinhados às metas da empresa.


2. Responsabilidades Principais

A. Prospecção e Vendas

• Identificar e abordar novas oportunidades de negócio.

           • Realizar apresentação de produtos/serviços da empresa.

• Elaborar propostas comerciais e conduzir negociação até o fechamento.

           • Realizar visitas comerciais


B. Gestão da Carteira de Clientes

           • Atender e acompanhar a base atual de clientes.

           • Identificar oportunidades de expansão (upsell/cross-sell).

           • Garantir a satisfação e a retenção dos contratos ativos.

           • Acompanhar pós-venda e resolver demandas comerciais.


C. Operações Comerciais

           • Cumprir metas mensais definidas para vendas novas e carteira.

           • Registrar todas as atividades no CRM

           • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com a coordenação/comercial.


3. Requisitos Obrigatórios

           • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas e gestão de carteira.

           • Conhecimento em negociação, relacionamento com clientes e rotinas comerciais.

           • Organização, boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

           • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e indicadores.

           • CNH B e disponibilidade para deslocamentos

           • Escolaridade: Mínimo ensino médio completo (preferência ensino superior em andamento/completo – Administração, Comercial, Marketing ou áreas correlatas).


4. Competências Comportamentais

           • Proatividade e autonomia.

           • Capacidade de resolução de problemas.

           • Boa postura comercial e perfil comunicativo.

           • Organização e disciplina para gestão de agenda e funil de vendas.

           • Trabalho em equipe e alinhamento com processos internos.

           • Empatia e foco no cliente.


•             Modalidade: PJ

           •         Remuneração: A combinar

           •         Local de atuação: Chapecó -SC

  • Venha crescer com a gente!

title: Senior React Native Engineer - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
About the Role

We’re building a talent pool for Senior React Native Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable mobile systems , and following best practices for architecture, performance, and maintainability.


What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain high-performance mobile apps using React Native and TypeScript.

- Design app architecture and manage state, navigation, and offline workflows.

- Integrate native iOS/Android modules and platform-specific features.

- Optimize performance and ensure maintainable, secure code.

- Collaborate with backend and product teams, contributing to technical decisions and releases.

- 5+ years of React Native experience.

- Strong proficiency TypeScript and modern state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, Recoil, or equivalent ).

- Deep understanding of mobile app architecture : navigation, performance tuning, offline-first workflows, and background tasks.

- Experience with native iOS/Android modules (bridging, push notifications, secure storage).

- Proven ability to design and deliver apps that meet security and compliance standards (secure data storage, encryption, RBAC).

- Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile and release processes for App Store/Google Play.

- Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate across backend, DevOps, and product teams.

- Prior experience contributing to technical decision-making and architecture discussions.


Nice to Have

- Familiarity with GCP, Firebase, or mobile analytics frameworks.

- Experience building cross-platform libraries or contributing to open-source React Native projects.

- Hands-on work with GraphQL and secure API integrations.

- Understanding of mobile accessibility (WCAG) and performance monitoring tools.

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.

  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.

  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.

Nice to have

title: Consultor funcional de Oracle AP
description:
A SOMMA IT está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Oracle Cloud AP para integrar nosso time em projetos desafiadores de implementação, rollout e sustentação.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em projetos de Oracle Cloud , com foco nos módulos:
  • Accounts Payable (AP): parametrização do módulo, fluxos de aprovação (BPM), fluxo de pagamentos, retenções e integrações bancárias.
  • Fiscal Document Capture (FDC): configuração de regras fiscais, de/para de itens, captura e validação de documentos eletrônicos (NFe, NFSe).
  • Tax (Impostos): modelagem fiscal, retenções na fonte, regras tributárias e parametrização dos motores de cálculo de impostos.
  • Diferencial – Cash Management: parametrização, conciliação bancária, gestão de extratos e previsão de caixa.
  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos (As Is), preparação de workshops (To Be), configuração do sistema e elaboração de documentos funcionais.
  • Apoiar o cliente em testes, homologações e sustentação (AMS).
  • Atuar como elo entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócio do cliente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como consultor(a) funcional em Oracle Cloud (AP, FDC e Tax).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos financeiros, fiscais e de tesouraria no cenário brasileiro.
  • Vivência com integrações fiscais (motores fiscais, SEFAZ, bancos, VAN bancárias).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, visão de processo e foco em entrega de valor.
  • Desejável: inglês intermediário, experiência em consultorias, atuação em projetos remotos e presenciais.

Se você busca atuar em projetos estratégicos e ter a oportunidade de crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, vem para a SOMMA IT !

title: Operations & Partnerships Coordinator
description:
Sobre a Matchfood / Sobrou.app


A fome é um dos maiores desafios do Brasil e do mundo — e ela convive todos os dias com toneladas de alimentos sendo desperdiçadas.


A Matchfood existe para enfrentar esse paradoxo.


Através do Sobrou.app, conectamos alimentos excedentes a instituições sociais, transformando desperdício em impacto social real — uma maneira simples de mudar vidas.


O desafio


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para apoiar a expansão da operação da Matchfood e fortalecer nossa rede de parceiros.


Essa posição conecta empresas doadoras, instituições sociais e operação da plataforma, garantindo que o impacto aconteça na prática.


Responsabilidades


• Apoiar expansão da rede de parceiros

• Apoiar relacionamento com instituições sociais e parceiros

• Coordenar onboarding de novas instituições

• Acompanhar operações de doação e impacto

• Organizar dados e informações de operação

• Contribuir para melhorar processos operacionais


Perfil


Essencial


• Organização e atenção a detalhes

• Excelente comunicação

• Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia

• Conforto com ferramentas digitais

• Interesse por impacto social


Diferenciais


• Experiência em operações ou gestão de projetos

• Experiência com startups

• Experiência com impacto social ou terceiro setor

• Experiência com CRM ou gestão de dados


Modelo de trabalho


Remoto — Brasil

Contrato PJ


Remuneração: R$5.000 – R$7.000 / mês


Por que trabalhar na Matchfood


• Impacto real no combate à fome

• Trabalho com propósito e impacto social

• Ambiente dinâmico e empreendedor

• Oportunidade de ajudar a escalar uma solução de impacto

title: Bilingual Accounting Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: Remote Bilingual Accounting & Administrative Specialist


MasterPro Installs is seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Accounting & Administrative Specialist  to join our remote team. This role is ideal for professionals based in Brazil  who have experience with U.S. accounting standards , QuickBooks , and operational financial administration.

As we continue to grow across North America, we’re looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and can deliver accurate financial data, organized records, and strong administrative support  that help leadership make informed decisions.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Accounting & Finance

  • Manage daily accounting operations, including accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and send invoices  to clients and track collections
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations  and investigate discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate general ledger entries
  • Assist with budget preparation, financial forecasting, and cash flow tracking
  • Prepare monthly financial reports  and support year-end accounting processes
  • Conduct internal reviews of financial data  to ensure compliance and accuracy


Payroll & Financial Administration

  • Manage and process payroll preparation and payroll reports
  • Coordinate payroll data with external payroll providers when necessary
  • Maintain organized financial and payroll records
  • Track contractor payments and verify payment documentation
  • Assist with expense tracking and financial documentation


Administrative & Operational Support

  • Support financial documentation, contracts, and internal administrative processes
  • Maintain organized accounting files and digital records
  • Assist leadership with financial insights and operational reports
  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure accurate billing and financial reporting


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • 3+ years of professional accounting or financial administration experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (Online and/or Desktop)
  • Practical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting processes
  • Strong Excel skills  (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, financial analysis)
  • Experience with invoicing, payroll coordination, and financial reconciliation
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment  while meeting deadlines


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Fully remote position with flexible hours
  • Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based leadership team
  • Exposure to multi-state operations and international business
  • Growth potential within a rapidly expanding company


If you're an accounting professional in Brazil  with strong command of U.S. accounting standards and administrative finance operations , we’d love to hear from you.


 Apply now or send your CV and a brief introduction.

title: Analista de Negócios Digitais | Inovação em IA
description:
Sobre a Ionix

Ajudamos empresas a construir capacidade interna de IA de verdade. Nada de projeto que acaba na gaveta — a gente constrói processo, capacita o time e fica junto até o cliente andar sozinho.


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos alguém para atuar junto às áreas de negócio dos nossos clientes, identificando oportunidades e construindo soluções com IA e automação. Você vai ser o profissional que faz acontecer: mapeia processo, entende a dor, monta o protótipo, testa e documenta o aprendizado.

Não é consultoria de relatório. É mão na massa.


O que você vai fazer

Entrar nas áreas, conversar com as pessoas, entender como as coisas funcionam de verdade e onde dói.

Transformar essas dores em hipóteses claras: \"se a gente automatizar X, o resultado deve ser Y\".

Construir protótipos funcionais usando ferramentas como N8N, Lovable, Lindy, Make e similares. Ciclos curtos de 2-4 semanas.

Testar, medir, aprender. Funcionou? Escala. Não funcionou? Documenta o porquê e parte pra próxima.

Ensinar as pessoas das áreas enquanto trabalha junto. A ideia é deixar capacidade instalada, não criar dependência.

Alimentar o repositório de conhecimento com casos, templates e lições aprendidas.


O que você precisa ter

2-4 anos de experiência em funções que misturam tecnologia e negócio: analista de processos, analista de sistemas, consultor de transformação digital, product analyst ou algo parecido.

Saber usar ferramentas no-code/low-code. Se você já montou automação em N8N, Make ou Zapier, já prototipou em Lovable, Bubble ou Retool, está no caminho certo.

Conseguir escrever bons prompts para LLMs e entender o que dá pra fazer (e o que não dá) com IA generativa hoje.

Noção de API, banco de dados e integração. Não precisa ser dev, mas precisa conseguir fazer as coisas funcionarem e resolver pepino quando trava.

Saber conduzir conversa de discovery: perguntar certo, mapear processo, identificar gargalo, estimar impacto.

Comunicação boa. Você vai falar com gente de negócio e gente técnica no mesmo dia.

Autonomia. Você vai estar atuando remoto, muitas vezes resolvendo sozinho. Precisa saber tomar decisão.


Diferenciais

Ter algo pra mostrar. Um projeto pessoal, uma automação que você fez, um protótipo que rodou. Qualquer coisa que prove que você constrói.

Experiência com Lean Startup, Design Thinking ou Jobs-to-be-Done.

Inglês pra consumir documentação e acompanhar o que está saindo de novo.


O que você vai encontrar aqui

Projetos de transformação em IA com empresas grandes.

Exposição a áreas e setores diferentes — você não fica preso numa caixinha.

Mentoria de gente sênior em IA e produto.

Ambiente onde o que você constrói vira caso, e o que você aprende vira treinamento pra outros.

Trabalho 100% remoto.


Processo seletivo

  • Conversa inicial pra entender seu momento. Case prático pra ver como você pensa e resolve problema. Papo final com a liderança.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About Flixr Studios

Flixr is a creative and growth studio working with DTC and gaming brands to build performance marketing engines that scale. We operate at the intersection of creative production and paid media, producing ad content that runs across AppLovin, Meta, TikTok, and emerging channels.


The Role

We're looking for a versatile Graphic Designer who can produce high volume, high quality static for DTC brands. You'll own the full creative pipeline: concepting, designing, iterating, and delivering production ready assets week after week.

This is a hands on execution role. You'll be the engine behind our creative output, producing the static ads, product compositions, video cuts, and variations that feed performance campaigns. The work is measured by what converts, not what looks prettiest in a portfolio.


What You'll Do

Static Ad Creative (Primary)

Design product focused ad creatives for DTC brands (dark, polished product compositions with brand copy overlays, lifestyle shots, before/after layouts, comparison cards). Produce 5+ base concepts per week with 3 to 5 variations each. Adapt winning formats across sizes and platforms (9:16, 1:1, 4:5). Maintain brand consistency while pushing creative boundaries.


What You Bring

Strong portfolio showing DTC or e-commerce ad creative. Mastery of Figma and Photoshop for static work. Understanding of what makes performance creative work: hooks, visual hierarchy, clear CTAs, benefit driven messaging. Ability to composite product photos cleanly on styled backgrounds. Experience producing creative for Meta, TikTok, or AppLovin is a strong plus. Self directed and reliable.


What We're NOT Looking For

Brand identity designers who focus on logos and guidelines. Motion graphics specialists who need a week per deliverable. Anyone who needs detailed creative briefs for every single asset. Designers who prioritize awards over results.


Application Process

Apply to this role on LinkedIn

All candidates will be sent an assessment to be completed

Please spent 1-2 hours on that assessment (you may not finish, that's fine), alongside:

  • An estimate of how many hours that assessment would take
  • Your hourly rate
  • Your resume/portfolio

Top candidates will be contacted for more work (this is a contractor role with a flexible workload)


Note, the assessment is not paid (it's there instead of interviews), while future projects are paid according to agreed upon rates!
company: Flixr - Creative Velocity for Paid Media.

title: US Immigration Legal Intern
description:
US Immigration Legal Intern


Location: Remote, Work From Home

Reports to: Legal Team

Type: Full-Time


Are you a law student or recent graduate (or studying a related discipline) looking to get hands-on experience supporting real U.S. employment-based immigration matters?

Beyond Border is looking for a US Immigration Legal Intern to support our growing practice. In this role, you’ll work closely with our internal legal team, gaining practical exposure to how high-quality petitions are built—from intake and evidence gathering to drafting support and filing readiness.


This is a rare chance to contribute directly to an impactful problem with an experienced, dynamic team.


About Beyond Border

Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform, built by immigrants, for immigrants. Our mission is to simplify global mobility, helping 10 million individuals and families pursue their dreams, no matter where they are.


Our first product focuses on assisting Tech Founders and Operators with navigating the complex U.S. immigration system, making their relocation seamless.

We are profitable from Day 1, and are experiencing more demand than we can handle at the moment.


Our team is building quickly to serve hundreds of high growth organisations to empower them to hire talent from anywhere in the world.


Who are you?

  • Currently pursuing a law degree (JD/LLB) or a related degree (e.g., public policy, international relations, business with legal focus), or a recent graduate seeking practical experience
  • Strong written English and attention to detail (you enjoy making documents clearer, tighter, and more persuasive)
  • Highly organized with great attention to details —comfortable working with checklists, deadlines, and multiple cases


Our Team

You’ll work directly with seasoned operators who have successfully built multi-million-dollar ventures, including Wework, Glints, MoneySmart, CardUp, and Solifi.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a Project Manage r to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and the internal team, ensuring expectation alignment, high‑quality delivery, and consistent communication. This professional will be responsible for leading projects end‑to‑end, ensuring that all deliverables are executed as planned while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Responsibilities

• Act as the central liaison between the client and the internal team, managing day‑to‑day communication and expectations.

• Own the project and all deliverables.

• Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with leadership and stakeholders.

• Develop project plans and communication documents, ensuring clarity and consistency.

• Estimate required resources and manage the project lifecycle using established methodologies.

• Create budget proposals, update financial forecasts based on SOW numbers, and propose adjustments when needed.

• Plan, schedule, and track project timelines, milestones, and resources, updating PSA Resource Forecasting weekly.

• Prepare and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.

• Manage scope changes proactively, identify potential crises, and build contingency plans while documenting risks, blockers, and changes.

• Define success criteria and ensure alignment across all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

• Conduct project post‑mortems and produce recommendations highlighting successful and unsuccessful elements.

• Maintain a centralized blocker tracker for the client, including due dates, owners, and impacts.

• Use tools like Confluence to document meeting notes and ensure all project meetings and updates are recorded.

• Build and manage risk mitigation plans and handle escalations when required.

• Collaborate with QA to plan and execute project demos, ensuring all requirements are listed and completed before each sprint.

• Address internal team blockers and ensure all members have access to code, documentation, and essential resources.

• Send and review client status reports summarizing progress, budget updates, risks, changes, and action items.

• Understand cross‑platform and cross‑project dependencies, collaborating with other Project Managers in the program.

• Conduct weekly internal steerco meetings to review issues, risks, and planning alongside leadership and the Program Manager.

Requirements

• Direct experience in a project management role, including process development and execution.

• Strong familiarity with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Basecamp, or similar platforms.

• Solid working knowledge of IT technologies across a broad range of solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal and operational abilities.

• Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast‑paced and high‑pressure environment.

• Hands‑on experience with project management practices and tooling to manage performance and deliverables.

• Proven ability to lead teams and drive projects to successful completion.

• Ability to lead development and implementation teams.

• Native Portuguese speaker.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field.

• PMP certification is a plus.

• Availability for travel, including onsite client meetings — primarily in São Paulo and Belo Horizonte.

• Medical Assistance

• Dental Assistance

• Life Insurance

• Gympass

• Home Office/Education Assistance

Additional programs include:

• Training and development program

• Incentives for obtaining professional certifications (including Salesforce)

Diversity & Inclusion

title: Risk Control Analyst
description:

  • Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database , and summarize behavioral characteristics.
  • Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring , and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
  • Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Analyze existing risk management processes and policies , and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
  • Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above .
  • 1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
  • Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

Their platform orchestrates and automates the entire diagnostic journey, reducing clinical complexity while integrating comprehensive medical histories and collective platform knowledge.   • Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering teams, setting high technical standards.
  • Experience working in complex domains, ideally U.S. Healthcare.
  • English fluency required.

Strengths We Value:

  • Strategic, systems-level thinking and ownership of end-to-end backend architecture.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments while maintaining high reliability and correctness.

title: Lawyer
description:

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

title: Creator & Influencer Sourcing Specialist
description:
About ContentJet

ContentJet is a global creative production company specializing in high-performing UGC and creator-led ads for brands advertising on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.


Our model combines a global network of creators, performance-driven creative strategy, and AI-assisted production systems to produce large volumes of social media content at scale.

As demand grows, we are expanding our global creator network and building one of the most efficient creator supply systems in the industry.


We are hiring a Head of Creator Partnerships & Expansion to lead this effort.


The Role

We are looking for a highly organized, internet-savvy Creator & Influencer Sourcing Specialist to serve as the tactical engine that keeps our creative projects moving. Your mission is to fill creator casting needs fast and accurately by turning client requirements into qualified, client-ready shortlists. You are the ultimate talent scout—spending your days hunting for the perfect creators, reaching out directly, and securing the right candidates for our campaigns.


What You Will Do

  • Creator Hunting & Sourcing: You will build structured sourcing plans to hunt for external creators across social platforms. You will use search signals and keywords to find niche talent quickly, rather than relying on luck.
  • Outbound Outreach & Pitching: You will execute high-volume outbound outreach via DMs and emails. You will clearly explain the project scope and requirements, pitching the opportunity to creators in a concise, persuasive way.
  • Negotiating & Confirming Terms: You will negotiate and confirm practical constraints with the creators, including their availability, delivery timelines, location, and usage rights terms.
  • Requirement Translation: You will turn messy client input into a crisp casting spec, identifying exact must-haves, lifestyle cues, and brand risk exclusions so you know exactly who to look for.
  • Upfront Quality Screening: You will protect quality upfront by validating a creator's audio/lighting viability, their on-camera tone and presence, and their ability to show products naturally.
  • Finding the Right Options (Shortlisting): You will build highly curated shortlist packs featuring 5-12 primary creator options that perfectly match the brief, packaging their links, bios, and performance vibes for client approval.


What You Won't Do

We believe in strict operational boundaries so you can focus entirely on talent discovery:

  • You stop at approval. Once your shortlist of creators is approved by the client, you hand off the execution to the Creative Fulfillment Specialist.
  • You do NOT own: formal contract execution, scheduling, shipping tracking, chasing deliverables, or paying the creators.


Skills & Experience Needed

  • 2+ years of concrete professional experience in influencer marketing, talent sourcing, creator casting, or a heavily outbound-focused outreach role.
  • Influencer / Creator Discovery: You have proven experience actively hunting and finding influencers or UGC creators for brand campaigns. You know the ins and outs of searching TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube for niche talent.
  • Outreach & Negotiation: You are an expert at persuasive outreach copy. You can DM or email creators without sounding spammy, clearly explain a project's scope, and get fast \"yes/no\" decisions.
  • Vetting Judgment: You have a strong eye for what makes a creator a good fit for performance UGC and you maintain strong brand safety awareness.
  • Pacing & Organization: You track many candidates simultaneously and maintain strong documentation habits.
  • Language Fluency: Fluent written English is absolutely required for crafting persuasive pitches and clear internal documentation. Written fluency in Spanish is highly preferred (though not mandatory).


How We Measure Success

  • Speed: The time it takes you to move from a new casting ticket to a fully built shortlist.
  • Quality: High shortlist acceptance rates by our clients and a low creator mismatch rate (meaning the creators you find actually succeed on the project).
  • Efficiency: The daily volume of qualified creator leads you add to our bench through your outbound outreach.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% Fully Remote: Work from wherever you are most productive.
  • Quarterly Bonuses: We reward high performance with structured quarterly bonuses tied directly to your impact.
  • Fast-Growing Company: Join a rapidly scaling startup where your work directly shapes the company's trajectory and bottom line.
  • Build From the Ground Up: You will have the ultimate autonomy to design, test, and build our macro-growth systems and team operations exactly how you envision them.
  • Opportunities to Grow: As you scale our creator network and build out our operations, there will be clear, accelerated pathways to grow your career and your team within the company.

title: ESPECIALISTA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS - GLOBAL MOBILITY
description:
QUEM SOMOS?


Prazer, somos a Suzano!

Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.


PLURAL


Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

Responsabilidades e atribuições



O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?


Atuar de maneira consultiva e como liderança técnica para transferências internacionais, expatriações, localizações e repatriações, considerando:

Planejamento:

  • Desenvolver estratégias alinhadas aos objetivos da empresa, elaborar processos robustos e garantir sua execução;
  • Planejar e monitorar o orçamento anual para os movimentos globais.

Gestão do Processo:

  • Envolver Parceiros de Negócio, Liderança e Fornecedores para garantir um processo personalizado, adequado às necessidades da pessoa movimentada e às Políticas de movimentação;
  • Liderar a agenda de movimentação, pensando em todo seu planejamento e aspectos financeiros, logísticos e documentação, alocação, preparação intercultural, questões trabalhistas, tributárias, previdenciárias, migratórias, onboarding, metas e objetivos, acompanhamento, carreira e retorno ou novo movimento (quando aplicável);
  • Garantir que a empresa e pessoas movimentadas estejam em conformidade com todas as regulamentações locais e internacionais;
  • Avaliar fornecedores, mantendo um relacionamento saudável, identificando e propondo oportunidades no produto/serviço.

Análise e Relatórios:

  • Coletar e analisar dados como custos, eficácia e tendências;
  • Preparar relatórios destacando o impacto da mobilidade global nos objetivos da empresa e fazendo recomendações.

Projetos:

  • Atuar em projetos da área, com foco na experiência das pessoas, simplificação/harmonização, melhoria contínua dos processos e sua automação/digitalização.


QUEM NOS INSPIRA?


  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência sólida em Global Mobility;
  • Vivência em gestão de expatriados e processos correlatos (vistos, tax compliance, benefícios internacionais);
  • Inglês fluente (comunicação diária em inglês);
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas de gerenciamento de mobilidade (desejável Workia);
  • Experiência com fornecedores globais e entendimento de processos internacionais de RH será um diferencial.


Informações adicionais

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);

Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;

Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;

Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;

Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;

Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos;

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas família, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial;

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira baixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de auto cuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on-line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.

#VemSerSuzano #PlantamosOCuidado #OrgulhoEmPertencer

MUITO PRAZER, NÓS SOMOS A SUZANO!

Somos uma empresa multinacional brasileira, referência global no desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras , de origem renovável, por meio do plantio de árvores de eucalipto. E elas estão no centro do nosso propósito, que é o de “renovar a vida a partir da árvore”. É assim que nós plantamos um futuro mais sustentável para o planeta e para as pessoas .

Temos 100 anos de vida, e hoje, somos a maior fabricante de celulose do mundo e uma das maiores produtoras de papéis da América Latina . Nossos produtos atendem mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do planeta e nós exportamos para mais de 100 países. Quanto às unidades, entre administrativas e operacionais, estamos presentes também internacionalmente na Argentina, Áustria, Canadá, China, Estados Unidos, Finlândia, Israel e Suíça.

E, tudo isso só é possível por causa das pessoas da Suzano: somos a soma de cerca de 20 mil colaboradores(as) próprios(as) e mais de 20 mil terceiros e terceiras, além de 300 colaboradores(as) em nossos escritórios internacionais . title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.

  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Figma/Webflow/WordPress capabilities.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you!


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Decision Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Contract: 6–12 months (with possible extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)

Time Zone: Must be available to work in Eastern Time (ET)


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to drive performance measurement and build scalable, production-grade analytical solutions within a high-velocity supply chain environment.

This role goes beyond model experimentation. The ideal candidate must be capable of designing end-to-end decision intelligence solutions, from data modeling and advanced analytics to business impact measurement and stakeholder adoption.

You will operate in a fast-paced production ecosystem where reliability, scalability, and measurable business outcomes are critical.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement advanced analytics and AI/ML solutions to optimize supply chain performance.
  • Develop performance measurement frameworks aligned with business KPIs.
  • Build automated, production-ready analytical pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable data solutions.
  • Ensure high standards of code quality, testing, documentation, and model governance.
  • Drive stakeholder adoption by clearly communicating insights and quantifying business impact.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in advanced analytics, decision science, and applied AI/ML.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL .
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML solutions in cloud environments (GCP, Azure, Databricks).
  • Experience with modern data platforms and analytics engineering (Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses).
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot).
  • Experience working in production-grade environments with scalable data systems.
  • Strong product mindset and experience delivering solutions using agile methodologies.
  • Proven ability to quantify business value and align analytical solutions with strategic objectives.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.


What We’re Looking For

  • Someone comfortable operating in ambiguity.
  • A professional who understands the difference between building models and driving decisions.
  • A data scientist who prioritizes measurable impact over academic experimentation.
  • A collaborator who can influence stakeholders and drive adoption across business teams.

title: Monitor (a) de Pesquisa Pleno - CRA II
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO


Gerenciar os centros de pesquisa de um determinado estudo e realizar monitoria dos centros de pesquisa do Brasil e/ou LATAM. Suporte aos monitores CRA I.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Realizar visitas de monitoria on-site ou remotas (visitas de seleção, iniciação, periódicas e encerramento) de acordo com o escopo de trabalho contratado e os requisitos regulatórios, ou seja, as diretrizes de Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e da Conferência Internacional de Harmonização (ICH).
  • Trabalhar com os centros para adaptar, impulsionar e rastrear o plano de recrutamento dos participantes de acordo com as necessidades do projeto para aumentar a previsibilidade.
  • Administrar protocolo e treinamento de estudo relacionado aos centros designados e estabelecer linhas regulares de comunicação com os centros para gerenciar expectativas e problemas contínuos do projeto.
  • Avaliar a qualidade e integridade das práticas do centro relacionadas à condução adequada do protocolo e adesão aos regulamentos aplicáveis. Escalar problemas de qualidade conforme apropriado.
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Certificar-se de que cópias/originais (conforme necessário) dos documentos do centro estejam disponíveis para arquivamento no TMF e verificar se o ISF é mantido de acordo com GCP/ICH e requisitos regulatórios locais.
  • Criar e manter documentação apropriada relativa ao gerenciamento do centro, monitorar resultados de visitas e planos de ação, enviando relatórios de monitoria, gerando cartas de acompanhamento e outra documentação de estudo necessária.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores.
  • Colaborar e estabelecer ligação com os membros da equipe de estudo para apoio à execução do projeto, conforme apropriado.
  • Se aplicável, ser responsável pela gestão financeira do centro.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA I, incluindo a realização de visitas de co-monitoria e treinamento.


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica

Graduação na Área da Saúde (Farmácia, Fisioterapia, Enfermagem, Biologia, Biomedicina, entre outras), pós-graduação na área preferencialmente, formação em pesquisa clínica


- Requisitos Técnicos:

Disponibilidade para viajar pelo menos 60% do tempo.


- Experiência:

Pelo menos 18 meses de experiência em pesquisa, experiência prévia em monitoria.


- Idiomas (Opcional):

Inglês: Avançado.

Espanhol necessário para monitores LATAM.


- Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação
  • Gerenciamento do tempo
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Coerência

description:
Cód. 58557


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei BA, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

• Experiência em Governança de Dados, Análise de Processos ou Engenharia de Requisitos , preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte.

• Vivência com ferramentas de catálogo e gestão de dados (ex.: DataPlex, OpenMetadata ou similares).

• Conhecimento em Metadados, Qualidade de Dados, Data Stewardship e MDM .

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de demandas como ServiceNow ou similares .

• Conhecimento em SQL para análise de dados e Power BI para acompanhamento de métricas e indicadores.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Account Executive
description:
Join us to witness the rapid growth of Keeta´s global food delivery business, experiencing firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking and expanding your international perspective while deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation


Responsibilities

  • Identify and secure partnerships with restaurants willing to collaborate with Meituan Keeta through efficient scheduling and in-person visits, and negotiate cooperation agreements.
  • Assist partner restaurants in setting up online delivery stores on the platform and provide training for managing their online business operations.
  • Offer professional solutions for merchants' takeout business operations, assist merchants in increasing their turnover, and achieve win-win cooperation with Keeta.
  • Conduct regular follow-ups with partner restaurants to maintain customer relationships and coordinate with various departments to resolve daily inquiries.


Qualifications


  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese as working languages; basic English reading and writing skills required, along with proficiency in using office software.
  • Strong business negotiation and market development skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and drive business partnerships.
  • Honesty, integrity, excellent communication, execution, and collaboration skills, as well as a strong sense of teamwork.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, resilience, and a willingness to take on challenges with an altruistic mindset. Primarily involves on-site visits to negotiate and provide services directly to merchants.

title: Head of Creator/Influence Partnerships
description:
About Content Jet

ContentJet is a global creative production company that produces high-performing UGC and creator-led ads for brands advertising on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Our model combines a global network of creators, performance-driven creative strategy, and AI-assisted production systems to produce large volumes of high-quality social media content.

As our client base grows, we are expanding our global creator network and building one of the most efficient creator supply systems in the industry.

We are looking for a Head of Creator Partnerships & Expansion to lead this effort.

About the role

We are looking for a hybrid leader who is equal parts Growth Marketer, Operations Manager, and Creator Economy Expert. Your primary mission is to build a highly scalable, automated engine that constantly attracts new creators to our network.

Alongside building this macro-level growth strategy, you will also directly manage our internal teams responsible for casting creators and fulfilling client projects. You will build the processes that transition us away from manual talent scraping, ensuring we always have a fresh, high-quality pool of creators ready to work.

What you do
  • Macro Acquisition Strategy : Design and build scalable systems to constantly attract new, high-quality creators to our network so we never have to manually hunt for them. You own our big-picture growth.
  • Team Leadership & Operations: Directly manage our internal project sourcing and fulfillment teams. You will use their daily challenges—like figuring out which creator niches are too hard to find—to decide exactly which types of creators we need to recruit next.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Build long-lasting relationships with creator communities, talent agencies, and industry coaches to ensure a steady, incoming stream of talent. You will secure recurring agreements so our supply is continuous.
  • Supply Forecasting (Demand Sensing): Look ahead to see what kinds of creators our clients will need—such as specific demographics, languages, or content styles. Your job is to forecast these gaps and recruit the right creators before we urgently need them.
  • Growth Campaigns: Act like a marketing team by running weekly \"casting calls\" and targeted ads designed specifically to attract creators who fill gaps in our roster.
  • Quality Control & Database Building: Set strict quality standards for who gets to join our network. You will organize our creator database so it is incredibly easy for our team to search and instantly find the perfect person for a job.
What we're looking for
  • A Growth Marketing Expert: You have a strong background in performance marketing and growth strategy. You are highly comfortable with funnel metrics, conversion optimization, and running experiments to acquire new users at scale.
  • A Creator Economy Native: You deeply understand the creator landscape and have a proven track record of building partnerships, negotiating mutually beneficial deals, and creating referral ecosystems.
  • An Operations & People Leader: You have experience managing fast-paced teams and can smoothly translate business needs into operational reality without stepping on toes.
  • A Data-Driven Forecaster: You measure success through concrete metrics (like cost-per-acquisition) rather than vanity metrics. You can accurately build a supply map and forecast talent deficits to prevent operational fire drills.
Required experience
  • 5+ years in Growth or Performance Marketing: Proven experience building multi-channel acquisition systems , running targeted paid ads, building landing pages, and writing acquisition copy.
  • 3+ years in the Creator/Influencer Economy: Significant professional experience working at a creator network, influencer agency, user-generated content platform, or creator-facing tech startup.
  • 2+ years in Partnerships or Business Development: A proven track record of successfully building relationships with creator hubs, agencies, or communities, and negotiating mutually beneficial referral deals.
  • 2+ years in Operations or Team Management: Direct, hands-on experience leading and scaling fast-paced operational teams, ideally in a sourcing, casting, project management, or fulfillment capacity.
  • Demonstrated Data & Analytics Experience: A clear job history of managing marketing funnels, measuring conversion rates, and optimizing campaigns for Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
Skills that will help you succeed
  • Strong understanding of marketing metrics (like cost-per-acquisition and conversion rates).
  • Business Development skills to negotiate mutually beneficial deals and build a referral network.
  • The analytical ability to turn daily operational roadblocks into smart, big-picture hiring decisions.
Why join us
  • 100% Fully Remote: Work from wherever you are most productive.
  • Quarterly Bonuses: We reward high performance with structured quarterly bonuses tied directly to your impact.
  • Fast-Growing Company: Join a rapidly scaling startup where your work directly shapes the company's trajectory and bottom line.
  • Build From the Ground Up: You will have the ultimate autonomy to design, test, and build our macro-growth systems and team operations exactly how you envision them.
  • Opportunities to Grow: As you scale our creator network and build out our operations, there will be clear, accelerated pathways to grow your career and your team within the company.

title: Translations Project Manager
description:
Translations Project Manager


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


This Project Manager will join our Translations Team. This team is responsible for the management of our translation, interpretation, and transcription services.


This role is responsible for overseeing the full translations project lifecycle — from ideation to completion — ensuring timely, on-scope delivery across all workstreams. The ideal candidate will coordinate internal teams and external vendors, maintain quality standards through thorough document review, and serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders. Strong organizational skills and experience with project performance tracking tools are essential.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage all lifecycle stages for a project from ideation through completion, with responsibility for ensuring that deliverables are understood and releases are delivered on time.
  • Ensure that all translations projects are delivered on-time and within scope.
  • Coordinate with internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of translations projects.
  • Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders.
  • Perform quality assurance functions that involve the careful review of documents for accuracy and consistency.
  • Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools and techniques.


Requirements:

  • Fluency in both spoken and written English.
  • Strong educational background.
  • At least one (1) year of professional work experience in an environment that required close attention to detail and high degree of organization.
  • The ability to balance multiple ongoing projects.
  • Clear, effective communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, as well as with remote teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Consultor funcional de Oracle AP
description:
A SOMMA IT está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Oracle Cloud AP para integrar nosso time em projetos desafiadores de implementação, rollout e sustentação.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em projetos de Oracle Cloud , com foco nos módulos:
  • Accounts Payable (AP): parametrização do módulo, fluxos de aprovação (BPM), fluxo de pagamentos, retenções e integrações bancárias.
  • Fiscal Document Capture (FDC): configuração de regras fiscais, de/para de itens, captura e validação de documentos eletrônicos (NFe, NFSe).
  • Tax (Impostos): modelagem fiscal, retenções na fonte, regras tributárias e parametrização dos motores de cálculo de impostos.
  • Diferencial – Cash Management: parametrização, conciliação bancária, gestão de extratos e previsão de caixa.
  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos (As Is), preparação de workshops (To Be), configuração do sistema e elaboração de documentos funcionais.
  • Apoiar o cliente em testes, homologações e sustentação (AMS).
  • Atuar como elo entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócio do cliente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como consultor(a) funcional em Oracle Cloud (AP, FDC e Tax).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos financeiros, fiscais e de tesouraria no cenário brasileiro.
  • Vivência com integrações fiscais (motores fiscais, SEFAZ, bancos, VAN bancárias).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, visão de processo e foco em entrega de valor.
  • Desejável: inglês intermediário, experiência em consultorias, atuação em projetos remotos e presenciais.

Se você busca atuar em projetos estratégicos e ter a oportunidade de crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, vem para a SOMMA IT !

title: Especialista SAP MM (Importação e Centro de Distribuição)
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Grupo Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 67.000 colaboradores e receita anual de aproximadamente €10 bilhões, atuando em 61 países sob duas marcas: Atos, voltada para serviços, e Eviden, focada em produtos.

Reconhecido como o número 1 na Europa em cibersegurança, computação em nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo Atos está comprometido com um futuro seguro e descarbonizado, oferecendo soluções completas e personalizadas, impulsionadas por inteligência artificial, para todos os setores.

O Grupo Atos é a marca sob a qual opera a Atos SE (Societas Europaea), empresa listada na Euronext Paris.

O propósito do Grupo Atos é ajudar a desenhar o futuro do espaço da informação. Sua expertise e serviços apoiam o desenvolvimento do conhecimento, da educação e da pesquisa com uma abordagem multicultural, contribuindo para o avanço da excelência científica e tecnológica.

Modalidade: Remoto
