title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a Project Manage r to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and the internal team, ensuring expectation alignment, high‑quality delivery, and consistent communication. This professional will be responsible for leading projects end‑to‑end, ensuring that all deliverables are executed as planned while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Responsibilities

• Act as the central liaison between the client and the internal team, managing day‑to‑day communication and expectations.

• Own the project and all deliverables.

• Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with leadership and stakeholders.

• Develop project plans and communication documents, ensuring clarity and consistency.

• Estimate required resources and manage the project lifecycle using established methodologies.

• Create budget proposals, update financial forecasts based on SOW numbers, and propose adjustments when needed.

• Plan, schedule, and track project timelines, milestones, and resources, updating PSA Resource Forecasting weekly.

• Prepare and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.

• Manage scope changes proactively, identify potential crises, and build contingency plans while documenting risks, blockers, and changes.

• Define success criteria and ensure alignment across all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

• Conduct project post‑mortems and produce recommendations highlighting successful and unsuccessful elements.

• Maintain a centralized blocker tracker for the client, including due dates, owners, and impacts.

• Use tools like Confluence to document meeting notes and ensure all project meetings and updates are recorded.

• Build and manage risk mitigation plans and handle escalations when required.

• Collaborate with QA to plan and execute project demos, ensuring all requirements are listed and completed before each sprint.

• Address internal team blockers and ensure all members have access to code, documentation, and essential resources.

• Send and review client status reports summarizing progress, budget updates, risks, changes, and action items.

• Understand cross‑platform and cross‑project dependencies, collaborating with other Project Managers in the program.

• Conduct weekly internal steerco meetings to review issues, risks, and planning alongside leadership and the Program Manager.

Requirements

• Direct experience in a project management role, including process development and execution.

• Strong familiarity with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Basecamp, or similar platforms.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About Flixr Studios

Flixr is a creative and growth studio working with DTC and gaming brands to build performance marketing engines that scale. We operate at the intersection of creative production and paid media, producing ad content that runs across AppLovin, Meta, TikTok, and emerging channels.


The Role

We're looking for a versatile Graphic Designer who can produce high volume, high quality static for DTC brands. You'll own the full creative pipeline: concepting, designing, iterating, and delivering production ready assets week after week.

This is a hands on execution role. You'll be the engine behind our creative output, producing the static ads, product compositions, video cuts, and variations that feed performance campaigns. The work is measured by what converts, not what looks prettiest in a portfolio.


What You'll Do

Static Ad Creative (Primary)

Design product focused ad creatives for DTC brands (dark, polished product compositions with brand copy overlays, lifestyle shots, before/after layouts, comparison cards). Produce 5+ base concepts per week with 3 to 5 variations each. Adapt winning formats across sizes and platforms (9:16, 1:1, 4:5). Maintain brand consistency while pushing creative boundaries.


What You Bring

Strong portfolio showing DTC or e-commerce ad creative. Mastery of Figma and Photoshop for static work. Understanding of what makes performance creative work: hooks, visual hierarchy, clear CTAs, benefit driven messaging. Ability to composite product photos cleanly on styled backgrounds. Experience producing creative for Meta, TikTok, or AppLovin is a strong plus. Self directed and reliable.


What We're NOT Looking For

Brand identity designers who focus on logos and guidelines. Motion graphics specialists who need a week per deliverable. Anyone who needs detailed creative briefs for every single asset. Designers who prioritize awards over results.


Application Process

Apply to this role on LinkedIn

All candidates will be sent an assessment to be completed

Please spent 1-2 hours on that assessment (you may not finish, that's fine), alongside:

  • An estimate of how many hours that assessment would take
  • Your hourly rate
  • Your resume/portfolio

Top candidates will be contacted for more work (this is a contractor role with a flexible workload)


Note, the assessment is not paid (it's there instead of interviews), while future projects are paid according to agreed upon rates!
company: Flixr - Creative Velocity for Paid Media.

title: Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios)
description:
VENDEDOR EXTERNO (GESTOR DE NEGÓCIOS) – COMERCIAL PJ


A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. Com uma trajetória marcada pela excelência e inovação, a empresa oferece soluções completas e personalizadas para atender às necessidades de segurança de seus clientes, sejam eles residenciais, comerciais ou industriais.

A atuação da Patrimonial Segurança é pautada em três pilares fundamentais:


· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

· Equipe Altamente Capacitada: Os profissionais da Patrimonial Segurança passam por rigorosos processos de seleção, treinamento contínuo e atualizações, assegurando que estejam preparados para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios de segurança.

· Atendimento Personalizado: Cada cliente recebe uma análise detalhada das necessidades de segurança, resultando em planos de ação específicos, capazes de prevenir riscos e proteger bens e pessoas de maneira eficaz.

A empresa se destaca por sua ética profissional, compromisso com a qualidade e foco na construção de relacionamentos de confiança com seus clientes.

Com presença sólida na região de Chapecó e Itajaí, a Patrimonial Segurança é mais do que uma prestadora de serviços; é uma parceira estratégica na proteção de bens e na promoção da tranquilidade.

Estamos em busca de um (a) Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios (a)) – Comercial PJ para integrar nosso time!


1. Objetivo da Função

Atuar na prospecção, venda e gestão de novos contratos, além de realizar o atendimento e manutenção da carteira ativa de clientes, garantindo resultados comerciais consistentes e alinhados às metas da empresa.


2. Responsabilidades Principais

A. Prospecção e Vendas

• Identificar e abordar novas oportunidades de negócio.

           • Realizar apresentação de produtos/serviços da empresa.

• Elaborar propostas comerciais e conduzir negociação até o fechamento.

           • Realizar visitas comerciais


B. Gestão da Carteira de Clientes

           • Atender e acompanhar a base atual de clientes.

           • Identificar oportunidades de expansão (upsell/cross-sell).

           • Garantir a satisfação e a retenção dos contratos ativos.

           • Acompanhar pós-venda e resolver demandas comerciais.


C. Operações Comerciais

           • Cumprir metas mensais definidas para vendas novas e carteira.

           • Registrar todas as atividades no CRM

           • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com a coordenação/comercial.


3. Requisitos Obrigatórios

           • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas e gestão de carteira.

           • Conhecimento em negociação, relacionamento com clientes e rotinas comerciais.

           • Organização, boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

           • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e indicadores.

           • CNH B e disponibilidade para deslocamentos

           • Escolaridade: Mínimo ensino médio completo (preferência ensino superior em andamento/completo – Administração, Comercial, Marketing ou áreas correlatas).


4. Competências Comportamentais

           • Proatividade e autonomia.

           • Capacidade de resolução de problemas.

           • Boa postura comercial e perfil comunicativo.

           • Organização e disciplina para gestão de agenda e funil de vendas.

           • Trabalho em equipe e alinhamento com processos internos.

           • Empatia e foco no cliente.

title: LDR – Lead Development Representative (Foco em E-commerce e Marketplaces)
description:
Sobre a Órbita Digital: Nós somos especialistas em escalar as vendas de e-commerces dentro dos maiores marketplaces do Brasil (Shopee e Mercado Livre). Nosso foco não é vender promessas, é entregar performance, gerenciar Ads e otimizar contas para lojistas que querem transformar suas operações em negócios de alto nível. E o nosso crescimento não para.


O seu desafio como LDR: Você será a ponta de lança do nosso time comercial. Sua missão será mapear, inteligenciar e qualificar os melhores lojistas do mercado para o nosso time de SDRs e Closers. 


O que você vai fazer na prática:

  • Prospecção Ativa (Outbound): Mapear donos de e-commerce no Mercado Livre e Shopee que se encaixam no nosso Perfil de Cliente Ideal (ICP).
  • Enriquecimento de Dados: Levantar informações estratégicas sobre as lojas (volume estimado de vendas, qualidade dos anúncios, deficiências técnicas) para munir nosso time de vendas.
  • Gestão de Pipeline: Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado, garantindo que nenhum lead bom fique para trás.


O que buscamos em você:

  • Experiência prévia com prospecção B2B, preferencialmente em modelos de Outbound.
  • Conhecimento básico sobre o ecossistema de E-commerce e Marketplaces (saber o que é Shopee, Mercado Livre, Ads e ranqueamento é um grande diferencial).
  • Resiliência e perfil \"Hunter\" (não ter medo de ouvir \"não\" e buscar o \"sim\").
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal impecável, direta e sem enrolação.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce ou similares).


Por que vir para a Órbita?

  • Ambiente de alta performance, focado em dados e crescimento real.
  • Oportunidade clara de crescimento (um bom LDR rapidamente se torna um SDR ou Closer).
  • Contato direto com estratégias de alto nível do mercado digital.


Modelo de Contratação

  • Modalidade: PJ


Pronto para acelerar com a gente? Envie seu currículo ou perfil do LinkedIn para com o assunto: \"Vaga LDR Órbita - (Seu Nome)\".

title: Analista tributário
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade para Analista Fiscal em Salvador (BA)! Buscamos um(a) profissional comprometido(a), analítico(a) e detalhista, com experiência em escrituração fiscal, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e entrega de obrigações acessórias como SPED Fiscal e EFD-Contribuições. A vaga é para atuação em escritório de contabilidade com clientes de diversos segmentos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Apurar tributos diretos e indiretos, como ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ e CSLL , garantindo a correta aplicação da legislação vigente.
  • Realizar a escrituração fiscal de notas fiscais de entrada, saída e serviços, assegurando a conformidade com as normas fiscais.
  • Elaborar e enviar obrigações acessórias, como SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, DCTF, DIRF, GIA, entre outras exigências legais.
  • Prestar suporte durante fiscalizações e auditorias tributárias, oferecendo informações precisas e documentação atualizada.
  • Acompanhar as atualizações da legislação tributária, analisando impactos nas rotinas fiscais dos clientes.
  • Oferecer suporte técnico para os clientes e para as áreas internas da contabilidade e do departamento fiscal.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência anterior em escrituração fiscal e apuração de tributos
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel)
  • Conhecimento de sistemas ERP e plataformas de escrituração fiscal


Requisitos desejáveis


  • Conhecimento do regime Lucro Real e Lucro Presumido
  • Experiência em escritório de contabilidade
  • Atualização constante sobre legislação tributária
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e comunicativo

CLT
